title: FixtureManifest
description: Immutable manifest describing committed trace seals for offline fixture verification; trusted git commit OID is supplied out-of-band to verifier, not stored inside manifest

manifest_identity_sha256.description: Canonical content identity sha256(canonical_json({manifest_version, entries})) computed over projection omitting manifest_identity_sha256 itself; semantic validator must recompute projection and reject absent or mismatched value as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

seal_path.description: Canonical relative path to seal file inside repo, confined to fixture root, normalized, no traversal

trace_set_path.description: Canonical relative path to ordered JSON array of InteractionTrace records for this interaction_id, confined to fixture root, normalized, no traversal
